outcome: Freed the captive Redcap from the witch who had enslaved and tortured him.
citation: s10 journal details Anise's enslavement and physical and psychological torment of Redcap; s50 says she attacked to prevent his escape; s60 [COMPLETE] records the witch dead and Redcap free to travel with the player.

outcome: Completed Hircine's Bloodmoon hunt and presented the wereboar's hide to win Bigpig's release.
citation: s30-s35 records Hircine's task and Bigpig's captivity; s70-s90 records killing and skinning the quarry and preparing the trophy; s130 [COMPLETE] records presentation to Hircine and Bigpig's return.
branch_note: The Daedric bargain and rescue motives genuinely coexist; any deity valence collision must be adjudicated before promotion.

outcome: Drank with Redcap through repeated tavern encounters with Sanguine.
citation: s5 begins the tavern drinking; s50-s90 repeat the drinking encounters; s100 [COMPLETE] recaps Sanguine's special brew and the three meetings.
branch_note: Sanguine never assigns the player a task or bargain and the artifact is bestowed on Redcap; no service or artifact-acquisition tag.

outcome: Honored Siodmak's memory by informing his lover and helping the Skaal salvage and preserve the horker harvest.
citation: s20-s40 records learning Siodmak's identity and informing Lon; s60-s110 records the memorial work of harvesting the slaughtered horkers and procuring salt; s120 [COMPLETE] says the player took responsibility and finished the work.
branch_note: The reward armor is gratitude for completed work; not a Daedric artifact.

outcome: Killed the attacking slaver Manos K'han and freed the captive Riekling villagers.
citation: s30 says Manos plans to kill the player and recapture Redcap; s40 records his defeat; s50-s70 records finding the cage key and freeing the villagers; s100 [COMPLETE] records their safe return.
branch_note: Open combat against an armed slaver; the player rescues Redcap's captive people and returns the Riekling villagers safely home.

outcome: Had Redcap cause a distraction at the Thalmor Embassy party.
citation: Objective: "Ask Redcap to cause a distraction at the party"; s20 is an untexted [COMPLETE] terminal. RUNTIME-VERIFY that this terminal fires after the distraction rather than merely after the request.
branch_note: Owner-approved tactical diversion; not wanton chaos and not forced into generic deceit.
